features: RETAINS FOOD FRESHNESS: With this Prepworks by Progressive Fresh Fruit and Veggie Keeper, you can extend the life and freshness of your fruits and vegetables

SPACE SAVING CONTAINER: This smaller size produce saver fits perfectly in the refrigerator on the shelf or door, yet still holds bunches of carrots, radishes, grapes, green beans or cherries ad you can conveniently wash and store all in one container
ADJUSTABLE VENT: The adjustable vent regulates air circulation while the water reservoir provides needed moisture

MULTIFUNCTIONAL: This fruit and vegetable keeper feature’s a produce storage guide printed on the front for quick and easy reference and you can easily remove the bottom lid and it will double as a colander
TOP RACK DISHWASHER SAFE: It can hold up to 7.5 cups (1.77 L) and is top rack dishwasher safe for easy, convenient cleaning
Place ONLY 1-2 TBSP of water in the bottom on those fruits/veggies where the water drop is noted.
description: With this Prepworks by Progressive Fresh Fruit and Veggie Keeper, you can extend the life and freshness of your fruits and vegetables. This smaller size produce saver fits perfectly in the refrigerator on the shelf or door, yet still holds bunches of carrots, radishes, grapes, green beans or cherries. You can conveniently wash and store all in one container. The adjustable vent regulates air circulation while the water reservoir provides needed moisture. This fruit and vegetable keeper feature’s a produce storage guide printed on the front for quick and easy reference and you can easily remove the bottom lid and it will double as a colander. It can hold up to 7.5 cups (1.77 L) and is top rack dishwasher safe for easy, convenient cleaning.
